name: pulse-range
title: Pulse Range
description: The day's heart rate as a glowing range: a capsule slides to the latest reading, its heart beating at that rate.

perf.budget: The capsule moves on a UI-thread spring on change. The heart is one view on a UI-thread loop, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The capsule jumps to its place, the heart holds still and the number does not count.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("Heart rate 112 beats per minute. TODAY average 74, low 52, high 168. JUST NOW.").
